With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.
